description: Build your own network of agents from Claude Code, Codex and Pi: persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.
rules: From this source checkout run ./install.sh --runtime codex and ./start.sh --name my-team --runtime codex (or select claude-code). Use the fresh scoped login command printed by startup; never copy old credentials.
Preview before launching: SoftwareTeam specs preview <spec>, then SoftwareTeam up <spec> --cwd . --plan, then SoftwareTeam up <spec> --cwd .
Check seat readiness with SoftwareTeam ps --nodes --software-team <softwareTeam>, not only daemon health from SoftwareTeam status.
Inside a softwareTeam, an agent runs SoftwareTeam whoami --json first and treats its output as its identity.
SoftwareTeam send <session> "message" types into a peer's terminal and presses Enter; SoftwareTeam capture <session> reads that peer's screen.
Work another agent must act on goes in the queue (SoftwareTeam queue create or SoftwareTeam queue handoff); a message informs but does not assign work.
Use SoftwareTeam start to bring softwareTeams back after a reboot or daemon restart.
Run SoftwareTeam --help for the current command surface; the CLI is authoritative over older examples.
